mapper.sql: select p.project_id, p.project_no, p.project_type, p.project_category, p.specialty, p.project_name, p.leader_id, p.budget_total, p.budget_balance, p.status, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.dept_id, p.del_flag, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, p.self_hosted, p.host_unit_id, ul.nick_name as leader_name, d.dept_name, hu.dept_name as host_unit_name from project p left join sys_user u on p.leader_id = u.user_id left join sys_user ul on p.leader_id = ul.user_id left join sys_dept d on p.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept hu on p.host_unit_id = hu.dept_id
mapper.update: update project set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0'
update project set leader_id = #{newLeaderId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0'
update project set budget_total = #{budgetTotal}, budget_balance = #{budgetBalance}, update_time = sysdate where project_id = #{projectId} and del_flag = '0'
